hero.title: Where virtual worlds get dressed.
hero.body: Phiegg is home for PFT clubs: hosts for your community, nests that grow into worlds and cities, and a feed of shots made for fashion.

pillars.title: Hosts
pillars.body: Your server, token-gated by verified ownership. Roles come from what you hold.

pillars.title: Nests
pillars.body: Click to nest: a channel, a quest, a world for your club, a city inside that world.

pillars.title: Shots
pillars.body: A visual feed of looks and world captures, tagged to the pieces you own.

pillars.title: Clubs
pillars.body: Every pool gets a home: pieces, holders, worlds and its host in one place.

pillars.title: Worlds
pillars.body: Showcase virtual, AR and agentic worlds, and invite people in from any shot.

pillars.title: Phipad
pillars.body: The accelerator. Cash, mentors and a launch slot for clubs that need them.

rows.label: Community space
rows.b: Host with nests that grow into worlds and cities

rows.label: Worlds
rows.b: Worlds and cities live inside the host

rows.label: Events
rows.b: Drops, runways and stages with RSVPs

cta.title: Hatch your club.
cta.body: Go direct or through Phipad. Same platform, same world.

stage._: The full-screen stage: the 16 Bold Cities (worlds of this origin), each shown whole over its own colours.

lead.title: Where virtual worlds get dressed.
lead.sub: Hosts for your community, nests that grow into worlds and cities, and a feed of shots made for fashion.

lead.title: Sixteen cities to step into
lead.sub: Zones to walk, hosts to join, shows on the runway and shops on every corner.

stage._lead: The first slides on the Home stage, before the cities: finished renders the user chose (2026-11-19).

ask.title: Chat
ask.body: Lora's Spark knows every look, city and drop. Ask her what to wear tonight, where the show is, or what a PFT is worth.
ask._fan: The pictures fanned out either side of the chat: finished renders of Lora's Spark's dresses with their shoes and bags (scripts/media/home-pictures.json), 2026-11-22. `fanShown` of them are picked on each visit, half a side; the first of the list always stands.
prompts: What should I wear in Lava City?

step.body: Each city is its own world: zones to walk, hosts to join, shows on the runway and shops on every corner.
step._centre: One picture standing large in the middle of the band, the pills (five then) around it.
step._picture: The pictures floating in this band, six at most. When the list is here they are shown whole in upright pills and are not pressed; without it the band shows the cities' posts (`post` below), each opening its post. 2026-11-22: the dress renders with their shoes, in place of the cities' duo posts.

gallery._: The finished renders on Home, in sets (scripts/media/home-pictures.json writes them): a tab per set and one for all of them; each set's pictures stand whole in cards of its `ratio`.
gallery.title: Renders

tour.title: Worlds
tour.body: Virtual cities, AR layers over real streets, and agentic worlds run by agent citizens - every world a club builds and runs.
tour._: Tour pictures are finished city renders and showcase posts, never screenshots of the app.

tour.title: Pools
tour.body: Clubs run pools of quests - the ways the next hatch gets made. Nests grow into worlds and cities; hosts are gated by what you hold.

tour.title: Feed
tour.body: Shots, looks and drops from across the worlds - tagged to the pieces you own. Every sale, quest and show earns $EGG.

post._: The posts the home page shows (its floating pills and its posts row): posts of this origin whose picture path holds `picture`. The cities' showcase scenes; the character posts wore stand-in Lora's Spark renders and are left out (2026-11-19).

cascade._: Every slider on Home: at least `min` cards, three in view (the middle the largest, a smaller one each side) and the next two as thin edges; cities are picked at random on each visit.
